title: Amino Z WPI 6kg $384.95 Delivered @ Amino Z
body:
Deal: Amino Z WPI 6kg $384.95 Delivered @ Amino Z

[OzBargainer4Eva] If you just want to buy the 5kg bags (IMPACT WHEY ISOLATE) you can get it for 348.99 for 5kg with the code 'AUSSIE' at MYPROTEIN
[johngrey] I'd be careful buying in bulk from myprotein since they almost always sent me protein super close to its best before date. I know you you can have it after the best before date as well but 3 times in a row I received multiple kilos that had their best before like 3 months after the purchase
[John Doh] When was this? I got them too, but not on recent orders made in the last 12 months. Probably 3 years ago I did get close to expiry protein.
[johngrey] The most recent one was around 2 months ago. I bought 2kg of casein and the best before was only 3 months after. The return was a nightmare as well, had to print my own label and pay for shipping back (which they said they would refund). Then they only refunded one kg and I had to reach out to them to refund the second kg. Then I had to reach out to them to refund the shipping costs…
[OzBargainer4Eva] @johngrey: I think i've gotten some a few years ago that was close to expiry date, but it was because i bought the stuff from the clearance section.
[nickelanddime] Myprotein is a dodgy company and their protein tastes awful, much rather Amino Z if it's the same price
[OzBargainer4Eva] Well, personally the flavours i've chosen all tastes really good, not sure which flavour you'd picked. I would also question AminoZ's dodgyability as they can't provide a lot of the lab results as well as their Certificate of Analysis (COA). Simple raw material origin they cannot provide.
[Pub Envelope] Anino Z really dropping the ball lately. I was going to take them up on their offer earlier last week but noticed they had no lab results for their Casein. Dropped them an email reply and was just told they didn’t have any lab results to send through.
[chintu123] Is this a must have? How does this impact the end user if you don't mind me asking?
[John Doh] Good to have, definiely not a must have. Pretty sure those guys will be sourcing from reputable source. Not supporting them or anything, but they are in the business for a long time now and would not screw up on such things.
[mjohan05] Might be targetted, getting invalid code.
[MMMMMISH] The code is NL-WPI6. OP missing 6, I dunno how to edit lol
[Nick K] Even with the 6, it doesn’t work. How did you get it to work?
[mjohan05] I chatted with a rep and confirmed it's targetted to specific accounts only.
[Downvoter] Enter a valid discount code or gift card
[iv18ozb] At this price is it really worth it? 1kg bag ($64.16) = 26.8g * 30 serves = 804g protein total. 500g lean beef mince has 100g protein, for $64.16 you get roughly 640 protein total. Both high quality protein, obviously not apple to apple, WPI has longer storage life and easier to consume, beef has zinc, iron, various vitamins and creatine, more satiating too.
[jackwoz] A protein shake is a lot better tasting than beef shake
[hasher22] Eating food is always more beneficial than a supplement. A protein shake is just what it is…. a supplement and shouldn't really replace real food if can be helped but damn a protein shake really helps.
I am in the trap of protein shakes myself, why should I eat, prepare 200g of chicken when I can easily drink 2 scoops of protein in a shake under 30 seconds.
For me I drink 2 scoops per morning and I know for a fact I won't compensate ~50g of protein from that shake with an additional meal throughout the day.
[Circly] At this price its cheaper to go anabolic route lol
[nomoneynoproblems] Was gonna suggested WPC, but WPC has gone up so much that this is actually a good price.
[nickelanddime] Can get WPC for ~$47/kg still. I used to be WPI only but switched because WPI got too expensive for not much extra benefit.
[hasher22] I think AminoZ needs to start looking into WPC and WPI/C blends to target more customer base that's looking for cheaper price point.
[John Doh] They have changed into premium business model. Like nvidia. I dont think they care anymore.
[hasher22] I think they still care, they have a great customer service team but I think they do want to position themselves as the WPI only brand, but IMO as a consumer and as a micro business owner myself, I think they would benefit even selling WPI/C blends but also, I wonder if they do sell WPC or WPI/C blends, is the price difference enough for people to buy. If it's only like $10 cheaper, then I wouldn't even bother
[John Doh] I am not doubting thier customer service at all, it is in fact top notch. What I mean by they dont care is - in reducing price point department. For example thier prices used to be much cheaper than VPA, now they are on par. That is what I meant by going premium.
[sherbules] They have a blend now called signature blend which is cheaper
Signature Protein
[DraggyX] That what I said many times. They has amazing customer services and had huge bargain fan base thru the previous sales, but then they were lack of market researches, focused on rew packaging, building premium brand with higher priced products resulted losing oz"bargain" fans
[OldBarging] WPI from Chemist Warehouse INC Nutrition in 2KG tub is $117, which works out to $58.50 per kilo. $64 per kilo for 5KG is not a deal.
[batrarobin] Sweetener (Sucralose).
AminoZ uses much better sweeteners and less fillers.
[OzBargainer4Eva] What is your definitely of 'better sweeteners' lol Want to know where you got your source from.
[batrarobin] Just open any single deal posted by AminoZ and you will get your answer in the description.
[bsm2122] Damn can't believe I was only paying $150 for 4kg with $65 credit only 2 years ago.
[hasher22] welcome to the protein slop phase in the marketing world now.
Every business is now trying to cash in with the protein slop BS now, this has now made the market saturated with misleading protein labelling which ultimately bumps everything else with a protein label up.
The fact whey protein started as a way to make use of a by-product of cheese-making, which eventually became a valuable commercial ingredient. Cheese factories wanted to get rid of it, someone found a way to harness the protein and to market the protein in it thus became a cheap and amazing source of protein….
Now everyone wants protein, we're paying the price.
[nickelanddime] Can't think of a single thing that hasn't been proteinified yet; chips, drinks, pancakes, coffee, brownies have all been hit…
[hasher22] Yup, I agree. The coffee protein makes me cringe. Moccona Protein Caramel Latte Coffee Tin 168g …. "Bovine Collagen (45%)", not even a full protein. This is getting stupid
[gaber] How do you even select 6kg from the website? Max I see for WPI is 5kg
